header: Sixty days to change your mind
subheader: The whole plan price back, no reason asked for.
lead: Changing practice software is a decision nobody can make properly from a demonstration. So the first two months are on the same terms as a purchase from a shop: if it is not right, you say so and the money comes back.
note: Applies to the plan price of a practice's first subscription. Ask by e-mail from the address on the invoice; the refund is transferred within five working days and your export goes out with it.

points.title: 60 days from your first invoice
points.text: Not from the trial and not from the contract date — from the day you first paid us anything.

points.title: The plan price, in full
points.text: Metered items already used and one-off work already delivered are not refunded.

points.title: Your data leaves with you
points.text: The full export goes out before the refund, not after it.

points.title: One e-mail is enough
points.text: No form, no call, no retention conversation. We do ask what went wrong, and you may ignore the question.
